notes.title: Ship Graveyard Simulator 2 - New challenges now available on PlayStation 5!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Shipbreakers! 🤝[/b][/h1]

[h3][b]New Challenges for PlayStation 5 owners! 🔵[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]Ship Graveyard Simulator 2 on PlayStation 5 have an exciting new challenge ahead with the arrival of two fantastic DLCs: Steel Giants DLC and the Submarines DLC. 🔥[/b][/h3]

🔸 Steel Giants DLC - https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/UP5805-PPSA22000_00-ULGSGS2STEEL0002

🔸 Submarines DLC - https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/UP5805-PPSA22000_00-ULGSGS2SUBMA0001

[previewyoutube=ddUp3ERrhok;full][/previewyoutube]
These DLCs have been released for console owners to enrich the console experience and offer fresh and engaging content that will test your shipbreaking skills like never before on console! 🎮

[h3]🔸[u][b]Steel Giants DLC on PlayStation 5[/b][/u][/h3]
Steel Giants DLC introduces a new range of massive, heavily-armored ships for you to dismantle. These colossal vessels will push your limits as you work through layers of tough steel plating and complex structures. Every part of these giants presents new opportunities for strategic dismantling and salvage, making this DLC a thrilling challenge on the PlayStation 5 console.

https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/UP5805-PPSA22000_00-ULGSGS2STEEL0002

[url=https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/UP5805-PPSA22000_00-ULGSGS2STEEL0002][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43183323/24decd802537049a8d684c6323cdad14d5cc71b3.jpg[/img][/url]

[h3]🔸[b][u]Submarines DLC on PlayStation 5[/u][/b][/h3]
Submarines DLC takes you deep below the waves to explore and break down underwater vessels. This DLC features a variety of submarines with unique designs and components that require a different dismantling approach.

https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/UP5805-PPSA22000_00-ULGSGS2SUBMA0001

[url=https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/UP5805-PPSA22000_00-ULGSGS2SUBMA0001][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43183323/3c5ca5eb115ce75d9b02dc9e867f5f595a9dae7d.jpg[/img][/url]

Together, these two DLCs bring significant new content and challenges to the PlayStation 5 version of Ship Graveyard Simulator 2. Whether you're conquering the towering Steel Giants or delving into the mysteries of the Submarines, these DLCs promise extra hours in the PlayStation 5! 

[url=https://discord.gg/evKuacn8uE][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43183323/c7358393778c5561461219e14c6db5bc9647f447.png[/img][/url]

Have fun!
Ship Graveyard Simulator 2 Team

notes.title: Ship Graveyard Simulator 2 | CO-OP Mode Playtest Are Open!
notes.content:
[h2]We are very pleased to announce that the CO-OP Mode Playtest has just started and are open to everyone! 💥[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2201940/Ship_Graveyard_Simulator_2/

[h2]👇 [u][b]IMPORTANT[/b][/u] 👇[/h2]
[h3][b]Please remember that these are Playtest of the upcoming version of CO-OP Mode - [u]it is not the final version[/u] - therefore, there may be some gameplay issues and bugs.[/b] [/h3]

If you encounter any bugs or something else, please let us know on Community Hub or our Discord, it will help us to improve the final version of CO-OP - thank you. 


[h3][b]🔶 For players who have signed up earlier[/b] - you can start playing the CO-OP Playtest now.[/h3]

[h3][b]🔶 For players who did not sign up before the start[/b] - first click the "request access" button and then you will automatically get access to the Playtest.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43183323/cece9ff7091de99b50c645877192263955ede73b.jpg[/img]

[h3][b][u]Playtest of the CO-OP Mode[/u][/b][/h3]
We decided to Playtest the upcoming CO-OP Mode because we plan to release it for the game in the upcoming 2024 and would like to hear the opinion of our community before we add it to the game. Playtest is something like beta testing, so you can feel like a real QA Tester!

[h3][b]General information[/b][/h3]
The game will have some restrictions against the full version of the game. Read carefully what you can expect! 
[list][*] The server has been limited to 3 players
[*] Available ships are[b] Maroon Lagoon[/b] (connector HP has been reduced) and [b]Caroline[/b]
[*] Players will get more money to start so they can buy both ships plus additional tool upgrades.
[*] For the duration of the playtests, the following will disappear from the game: [/list]- Winche
- Hazard
- Crouching
- Crane upgrades
- Mobile cargo along with input for walkie talkies
- Collectibles 
- Load option
- Continue option
- Credits

[h3][b]Warning:[/b][/h3]
[b]A new player cannot join the game while a ship is ordered! All players must be present before buying a ship[/b]



[h3][b][u]Suggestions and feedback[/u][/b][/h3]
We encourage you to send your feedback, suggestions, and bugs you may encounter. We will be very pleased if you leave your opinion about the upcoming CO-OP Mode, it is very important to us to listen to the opinions of our community. You can do this by:

[b]1. Steam Community Hub[/b], where we have created appropriate topics. We also encourage you to create your own.
[list][*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2201940/discussions/0/4036978063918499529/]📖 CO-OP PLAYTEST | SUGGESTIONS & FEEDBACK[/url]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2201940/discussions/0/4036978063918499655/]🐛 CO-OP PLAYTEST | BUGS & PROBLEMS[/url][/list][b]2. On our dedicated Discord[/b] - https://discord.gg/evKuacn8uE


[b]3. Directly in the Ship Graveyard Simulator 2 Playtest[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2567570/]Steam page[/url]


[h2][b]We can't wait to hear your first impressions! 😊[/b][/h2]

[url=https://discord.gg/evKuacn8uE][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43183323/25cdf2608fb8ca229fa863444a8fbfb772c1e50f.png[/img][/url]

Have fun!
SGS2 Team

notes.title: Ship Graveyard Simulator 2 | Update on the release date of Playtest CO-OP Mode
notes.content:
[h3][b]Dear community,[/b][/h3]

Last week we promised that the Playtest of CO-OP Mode would be available this week, but unfortunately, with great heartache, we have to inform you about the change of the Playtest release date.

Currently, the entire team is involved in bug fixes for Warships DLC, which really surprised us. As a small development team, we want to first improve the stability of the Warships DLC and then fully focus on the Playtest of CO-OP Mode so that you can fully enjoy smashing ships with hammers with your friends, that's why we need a few more days.

Therefore, we decided to change the Playtest release date to December 2023. We want to be absolutely sure that you - our community - who support our game by purchasing DLC, could enjoy the game without any problems.

Thank you for your understanding - the entire team is working very hard to make sure you can fully experience this next milestone with Ship Graveyard Simulator 2. We assure you that the Playtest version will be ready soon.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2201940/Ship_Graveyard_Simulator_2/


[b]We will get back to you with further information - thank you. 🤝[/b]
Ship Graveyard Simulator Team
